title: 814. Ambiguous Coordinates

examples.explanation: Splitting the digits as 1|23 and 12|3 and decorating each side with an optional decimal point yields four valid pairs.
Leading-zero and trailing-zero rules leave only one legal rendering.
The left part must stay 0 or 0.xxx while the right part varies freely.

hints: Strip the outer parentheses, then try every split of the inner digits into left and right halves.
A piece is valid as an integer when it is exactly 0 or has no leading zero; as a decimal it needs no leading zero unless it starts with 0. and no trailing zero in the fraction.
